item.title: This clever road sign in Austin will compliment you only if you’re a good driver
item.description: The carrot-instead-of-stick approach for an an insurance company activation brought a smile to motorists’ faces. One insurance company is taking the opposite approach with a new activation.New York City-based Lemonade created “The Slow Sign,” a digital sign that compliments drivers for following the speed limit.
